newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing to curb big commercial complexes - paper.
newsitem.headline: Beijing to curb big commercial complexes - paper.

text.p: The Beijing city government will restrict construction of new commercial complexes, the Market Daily said on Monday.
The newspaper, published by the official People's Daily, quoted city planners as saying they might halt some projects already approved but where construction had not yet begun.
Future approvals of new projects also would be screened closely, it said.
The Chinese capital now has 65 such large commercial centres either completed or under construction. Work began on 17 of them last year, the newspaper said.
Beijing's existing shopping centres have complained of intensifying competition over the past year.

Tianqiao Department Store, Beijing Wangfujing Department Store Co and Beijing Xidan Market Co Ltd are among the listed department store operators. All of their shares trade on the Shanghai stock exchange.
